Rohit Sharma Shrugs Off Retirement Buzz After Record Lords Century

Cricket star Rohit Sharma has responded to speculation about his retirement from international cricket, saying he will continue to play as long as there is 'noise' in the game. Sharma recently scored a record century in a Lord's match, sparking talk of his potential retirement. However, the batsman has dismissed these rumors, stating that he will keep playing until the excitement and noise around the sport remain.
